edges.description: Model routing is a Cognitive OS research/profile surface for choosing the full execution path; documentation does not establish that every routing policy is wired at runtime.
Anti-degradation research addresses context rot, goal drift and related long-horizon failure modes without implying the mitigations are already production-effective.
The evidence-use contract constrains downstream use of retrieved or verified material and preserves evidence, confidence and authority as distinct concepts.

Questions that survive replacement of the current model, graph, database or provider should be examined against the CLOS substrate-neutral research blueprint rather than promoted from the implementation profile.

Semantic obligations involving meaning, history, provenance, declared loss and non-escalation route to their owning semantic projects such as Native Kernel rather than remaining Cognitive OS implementation choices.
The culture repository README is the source-controlled ecosophical manifesto surface; cultural/philosophical claims remain distinct from technical architecture and scientific authority.
The State Validation Lab architecture document defines the bounded research-laboratory model and its non-production authority boundaries.
Execution status records E6 as implemented with exact-head evidence runs while E3 and E4 remain specified but not implemented or executed.
The E6 cross-check records owner-local semantic compatibility with referenced Native Kernel distinctions without transferring Native Kernel runtime or authority into the lab.
E6 uses Native Kernel only as a read-only semantic reference for compatibility; the lab keeps its fixture-local model and makes no adoption or authority claim.
RESEARCH_STATUS.md is the laboratory-wide current research route; exact frozen artifacts still outrank it for run-specific numerical claims.
SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md provides a human-readable lab mental model while remaining subordinate to run artifacts and current research status for empirical conclusions.
The retrieval-relevance thread should be read in the context of the laboratory-wide research status so FM-specific findings are not promoted into product/runtime authority.
